src/daemon/main.ts.reason: runs once before tetherd serves: mkdir of the home, pid file read / write / remove

src/doctor.ts.reason: only `tether doctor` calls it; tetherd imports it statically through the extensions' daemon.ts but never runs it

src/core/exe-sync.ts.reason: reached only through src/doctor.ts (`tether doctor`); never called by tetherd

src/trace/timeline.ts.reason: `tether trace` timeline reader (CLI); tetherd imports it statically but never calls it

extensions/browser/doctor.ts.reason: the browser extension's checks for `tether doctor` only

src/doctor-hands.ts.reason: the hands extension's checks for `tether doctor` only; tetherd imports it statically through extensions/hands/daemon.ts but never runs it

src/daemon/client.ts.reason: detached launch of ptyd / procd (spawnDaemon helpers): the child must outlive tetherd, so it cannot live in a worker

extensions/web-bridge/warmup.ts.reason: detached launch of the bridge daemon (stdio to a log fd, own process tree): same shape as the ptyd / procd launch

extensions/remote/daemon/portal.ts.reason: launch of the remote portal, once per switch-on: it needs a stdin for its credential (fio-spec 1.5) and an IPC channel, which neither a worker nor PowerShell Start-Process can hand over

src/remoted/notice.ts.reason: the portal's native notice (a PowerShell toast) per pairing begun, failed or done; runs in the portal's own loop, never in tetherd's
